description: This file defines the 'ConciergeMappingStrategies' class, which extends 'MappingStrategies' and provides singleton access to a collection of various mapping strategies used within the concierge service of the system. It aggregates strategies from different modules such as things, policies, search, connectivity, cache invalidation, and global strategies.

classes.description: A final class that extends 'MappingStrategies', providing a singleton instance that aggregates various mapping strategies relevant to the concierge service.
